thread:
maria (PM): Heads up  Enterprise prospect wants pilot but insists on team-level access controls + signed audit logs. They want a short checklist we can hit this sprint.

dan (ENG): Full RBAC + admin console is a multi-sprint effort. We can do a "pilot access" mode: IdP groups -> team mapping + two roles (owner/member) + event log. Low-risk if feature-flagged.

zoe (UX): We can surface a clear "Pilot access" banner during onboarding that describes limitations. Minimal mapping modal will work.

 tom (SRE): For audit: append-only logs with HMAC signing and S3 export should satisfy their compliance team for pilot. Retention config is v1.

 sam (AE): Customer will sign pilot if we provide a 45-60 day delivery window for full RBAC. Need acceptance criteria they can test.

 maria (PM): Proposal: ship MVP on time with "pilot access" mode gated by tenant flag; commit to full RBAC / admin console within 60 days of pilot start. Vote?

 dan (ENG): +1. Estimate ~4 engineer-days to wire mapping and event signing, plus tests for Okta/Azure. Feature-flag + canary deploy recommended.

 zoe (UX): +1. I'll design mapping modal and the banner copy. Keep language conservative: "Pilot-only controls".

 tom (SRE): +1. I'll create the S3 export bucket template and add runbook steps for verifying HMAC.

 maria (PM): Action items:
 - maria: draft amendment with acceptance criteria and 60d window (today)
 - dan: implement pilot access adapter + feature flag (5 working days)
 - tom: HMAC signing + S3 export template (3 working days)
 - zoe: onboarding banner + mapping modal (3 working days)
 - sam: confirm with customer and circulate contract (EOD)

 ci-bot: deploy 1967890300 to staging/product -- success :shipit:

 dan (ENG): PR opened (draft) for pilot adapter. Will add Okta test vectors.

 sam (AE): Customer verbally agrees to these ACs, legal wants the 60d window in writing. Circulating now.

 maria (PM): Good. Keep updates here; flag if any day slips beyond Day 7. We'll avoid changing public MVP messaging aside from a small note about enterprise pilot features.

 sam (AE): Contract signed. Onboarding scheduled Day 6. Thanks all. :tada:
